views.name: tracks_with_duration_minutes_and_revenue
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Track.TrackId AS track_id,
  (Track.Milliseconds / 60000.0) AS duration_minutes,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity)
    FROM InvoiceLine
    WHERE InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
  ), 0.0) AS revenue
FROM Track
views.description: Project each track with its duration converted to minutes and its revenue preserved; keep one row per track for downstream classification and aggregation.

views.name: global_duration_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MIN(t.duration_minutes) AS min_duration_global,
  AVG(t.duration_minutes) AS avg_duration_global,
  MAX(t.duration_minutes) AS max_duration_global,
  -- midpoint1: midpoint between min and avg
  (MIN(t.duration_minutes) + AVG(t.duration_minutes)) / 2.0 AS midpoint1,
  -- midpoint2: midpoint between avg and max
  (AVG(t.duration_minutes) + MAX(t.duration_minutes)) / 2.0 AS midpoint2
FROM tracks_with_duration_minutes_and_revenue t
views.description: Compute global summary statistics across all tracks: minimum, average, and maximum of duration_minutes, plus the two midpoints used to partition lengths.

views.name: tracks_with_length_category
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.track_id AS track_id,
  t.duration_minutes AS duration_minutes,
  t.revenue AS revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN t.duration_minutes <= g.midpoint1 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN t.duration_minutes > g.midpoint1 AND t.duration_minutes < g.midpoint2 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Long'
  END AS category
FROM tracks_with_duration_minutes_and_revenue t
CROSS JOIN global_duration_stats g
views.description: For each track (one row per track), attach the global duration stats and apply the Music Length Types rules to assign a category value 'Short', 'Medium', or 'Long' based on duration_minutes and the computed midpoints.

views.name: category_level_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.category AS category,
  MIN(t.duration_minutes) AS min_duration_minutes,
  MAX(t.duration_minutes) AS max_duration_minutes,
  SUM(t.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM tracks_with_length_category t
GROUP BY t.category
views.description: For each category (Short, Medium, Long) compute the minimum and maximum duration_minutes among tracks in that category and the total revenue (sum of revenue) for the category; one row per category.
